desc: The Long Ranger Deluxe Engraved editions are centered around a lightweight alloy receiver plated with highly polished nickel under beautifully executed scroll engraving on both side flats and lightly accented with 24 K gold inlay. Rear sight is folding fully adjustable, front sight is ramp w/.062" Ivory bead, drilled and tapped for scope. It features a walnut stock with black solid rubber recoil pad. Includes swivel studs and removable magazine.
